slides.prompt: Create a scientifically accurate hysteresis teaching diagram replacing the reference illustration; use reference ONLY for modern thin gray technical outlines, cream #F6F2E8, blue and golden yellow colors, clean contemporary style. Wide 3:1 image, legible on slide at 600x200pt. Horizontal LIGHT LEVEL axis points right from dark left to bright right. Exactly TWO distinct vertical dashed threshold markers at 30% and 70% of axis. At left/lower threshold show glowing yellow generic bulb and a small left-pointing arrow crossing that threshold, meaning falling light switches ON. At right/higher threshold show gray unlit bulb and right-pointing arrow crossing that threshold, meaning rising light switches OFF. Shade space BETWEEN thresholds light blue, and show a small blue zigzag entirely WITHIN this band as a symbolic fluctuating reading (not a time graph). Above band clear label 'ให้คงสถานะเดิม'. Left threshold label exactly 'เกณฑ์เปิดไฟ'; right threshold label exactly 'เกณฑ์ปิดไฟ'. Axis endpoints small labels 'มืด' on left, 'สว่าง' on right. These are the only five text labels, Thai modern sans serif dark green #163E33 large and accurate. No numbers, no other text, no center flow arrow, no sensor tile or connectors. Clean spacious layout, fully visible diagram, no overlap. Both threshold markers and the gap between them must be visually unmistakable. Keep bulbs modest size to prioritize diagram. No scenery, antique texture, shading gradients or photo effects.
